# Exhibit C: Support Services and Service Level Agreement

This Exhibit C forms part of the Master Subscription Agreement (the "Agreement") between Brightline Software, Inc. ("Provider") and Acme Logistics LLC ("Customer").

**Effective Date:** 2026-03-01

**Monthly Subscription Fees:** $12,500.00 per month, invoiced monthly in advance.

## 1. Definitions

1.1 "Business Hours" means 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.

1.2 "First Response Time" means the time between Provider's receipt of a support request through the support portal and the first substantive human response from Provider's support staff. Automated acknowledgements do not count as a response.

1.3 "Resolution Time" means the time between receipt of the request and the moment Provider delivers a fix or an acceptable workaround.

1.4 The Resolution Time clock is paused while a ticket is awaiting information or action from Customer.

## 2. Standard Support

Standard Support is included with every subscription. Targets are measured in Business Hours unless stated otherwise.

- Urgent (P1): first response within 2 business hours; resolution within 2 business days.
- High (P2): first response within 4 business hours; resolution within 3 business days.
- Normal (P3): first response within 8 business hours; resolution within 5 business days.
- Low (P4): first response within 2 business days.

## 3. Premium Support

Premium Support applies to Customer's production workspaces listed in Order Form #2291.

- Urgent (P1): first response within 30 minutes, 24x7; status updates every 2 hours, 24x7; resolution within 8 hours, 24x7.
- High (P2): first response within 1 business hour; resolution within 1 business day.
- Normal (P3): first response within 4 business hours; resolution within 3 business days.
- Low (P4): first response within 8 business hours.

For each Urgent ticket whose first response target is missed, Customer will receive a service credit of 5% of the monthly Subscription Fees, not to exceed 25% of the monthly fees in any calendar month.

## 4. Service Credits

4.1 If less than 95% of tickets in a calendar month meet their Resolution Time targets, Customer receives a service credit of 5% of the monthly fees; below 90%, a credit of 10%; below 80%, a credit of 20%.

4.2 Service credits are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for any failure to meet the targets in this Exhibit. Credits must be requested in writing within 30 days of the end of the affected month.

## 5. Availability

Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to make the Service available 99.9% of each calendar month. Availability commitments are governed by Exhibit D and are not support targets.

## 6. Exclusions

The targets do not apply to requests caused by Customer's misuse of the Service, to feature requests, or during scheduled maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance.
